dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains the three rapid transit lines. A separate dataset contains their stations. Only those portions within the boundaries of the City of Vancouver are shown.

Data currency

This data in City systems is updated as required in the normal course of business. The extract on this website is updated weekly. This dataset rarely if ever changes.

Data accuracy

As most of the line locations are underground, their locations are approximate.
